# Copilot instructions

- This repository is for a personal expenses manager Android app.
- Prefer Kotlin and Android best practices.
- Favor Jetpack Compose, Material 3, coroutines/Flow, Room, and MVVM for new app code unless the repo already uses different patterns.
- Keep changes small and consistent with existing project structure.
- Before editing code, inspect the related Gradle, manifest, and source files to match local conventions.
- Add or update tests when behavior changes.
- Avoid introducing new dependencies unless they clearly simplify the task.
- Keep UI text concise, user-friendly, and accessible.
